name: junction-monorepo
description: A deterministic engine for agent-authored educational games.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/spec packages/runtime packages/renderer packages/rooms packages/node packages/mcp packages/cli && pnpm --filter @junction/renderer run bundle && pnpm --filter @junction/cloudflare run build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm --filter @junction/cloudflare run check:deploy
